#loading the merged data soft metabolomics 
```{r}
load("Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS.RData")
```

1. Archetype score (outcome) ∼ protein/metabolite (exposure) + age + sex
#how much the archetype score changes per one-unit increase in that protein, after adjusting for age and sex.

2. Significant Metabolite/protein (outcome) ∼ Clinical variable (exposure)
#linear regressions to test whether selected metabolites are associated with different clinical phenotypes.

Since metabolomics panel is targeted, it may already be enriched for compounds known to be relevant to:

insulin resistance, dyslipidemia,glycemic traits, inflammation

So the targeted design itself increases the chance of discovering associations in this specific phenotype context.

since archetypes are associated with traits like: glucose HbA1c lipids BMI waist circumference blood pressure Those are all much more directly connected to metabolic biochemistry than to broad proteome-wide biology.
Targeted metabolomics often has cleaner quantification A targeted metabolomics platform usually gives: higher measurement precision lower technical noise more stable quantification fewer poorly measured features So even though you test fewer metabolites, those metabolites are often measured very well and are biologically selected to be informative.


Proteomics is broader and less phenotype-focused, so many proteins may simply be irrelevant to these archetypes.

Metabolites can easily produce more significant hits than proteins because:

archetypes are likely more metabolically driven

targeted metabolomics is often cleaner and more phenotype-relevant

untargeted proteomics has more noise and more tests

FDR penalizes the proteomics analysis more strongly

##Defining and Identifying the archetypes based on the tresshold
```{r}
Extreme.archetype_indices <- which(assignments_a3_M > 0.7, arr.ind = TRUE)
Participants.number <- data.frame(
  Participant_Number = Extreme.archetype_indices[, 1],
  Archetype_Number = Extreme.archetype_indices[, 2]
)
Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS$Extreme_Archetype_Number <- NA
for (i in 1:nrow(Participants.number)) {
  participant_id <- Participants.number$Participant_Number[i]
  archetype_id <- Participants.number$Archetype_Number[i]
  
  Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS$Extreme_Archetype_Number[participant_id] <- archetype_id
}
mixed_etiology <- which(apply(assignments_a3_M, 1, function(x) all(x < 0.7)))
Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS$Extreme_Archetype_Number[mixed_etiology] <- "Mixed Etiology"
```


#Running linear regression only for the proteins (outcome are archetype and exposure : protein and covariates: adjust for age and sex)
#how much the archetype score changes per one-unit increase in that protein, after adjusting for age and sex.
```{r}
clinical_vars <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS[, c("u3talteru", "u3csex")]
archetype_vars <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS[, c("Archetypes 1", "Archetypes 2", "Archetypes 3")]
protein_vars <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS[, 32:873]
results_list_prot <- list()
for (prot in colnames(protein_vars)) {
  prot_results <- list()
  
  for (archetype in colnames(archetype_vars)) {
    # Build the formula: archetype ~ protein + clinical covariates
    # Use backticks to handle spaces/special characters in column names
    formula_str <- paste0("`", archetype, "` ~ `", prot, "` + u3talteru + u3csex")
    model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS)
    
    coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
    conf_intervals <- confint.default(model)
    r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
    
    # Ensure the protein is present in the coefficient table
    if (paste0("`", prot, "`") %in% rownames(coefs)) {
      coef_name <- paste0("`", prot, "`")
    } else if (prot %in% rownames(coefs)) {
      coef_name <- prot
    } else {
      coef_name <- NA
    }
    
    if (!is.na(coef_name)) {
      estimate <- coefs[coef_name, "Estimate"]
      se <- coefs[coef_name, "Std. Error"]
      p_value <- coefs[coef_name, "Pr(>|t|)"]
      ci_lower <- conf_intervals[coef_name, 1]
      ci_upper <- conf_intervals[coef_name, 2]
    } else {
      estimate <- NA
      se <- NA
      p_value <- NA
      ci_lower <- NA
      ci_upper <- NA
    }
    
    prot_results[[archetype]] <- data.frame(
      Protein = prot,
      Archetype = archetype,
      Estimate = estimate,
      Std_Error = se,
      P_value = p_value,
      CI_Lower = ci_lower,
      CI_Upper = ci_upper,
      R2 = r2,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  results_list_prot[[prot]] <- do.call(rbind, prot_results)
}
final_results_prot <- do.call(rbind, results_list_prot)
final_results_prot$Adjusted_P_value <- p.adjust(final_results_prot$P_value, method = "fdr")
write.csv(final_results_prot, paste0("Proteins_Archetype_Regression_Results_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
significant_results <- final_results_prot[final_results_prot$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05, ]
head(significant_results[order(significant_results$Adjusted_P_value), ])

range(significant_results$Estimate)
```

##Heatmap of archetypes vs top proteins
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
heatmap_matrix <- top10_proteins %>%
  dplyr::select(Protein_Short_Unique, Archetype, Estimate) %>%  # Explicit dplyr call
  pivot_wider(names_from = Archetype, values_from = Estimate) %>%
  as.data.frame()


# Set short names as rownames and remove the column
rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_matrix$Protein_Short_Unique
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix %>% dplyr::select(-Protein_Short_Unique)
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(heatmap_matrix)
heatmap_matrix <- type.convert(heatmap_matrix, as.is = TRUE)
heatmap_matrix[!is.finite(heatmap_matrix)] <- 0
max_abs_value <- max(abs(heatmap_matrix))
color_breaks <- c(-max_abs_value, -max_abs_value/2, 0, max_abs_value/2, max_abs_value)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = color_breaks,
  colors = c("darkblue", "dodgerblue", "#FFFDD0", "salmon", "darkred"),
  space = "LAB"
)
ht <- Heatmap(
  matrix = heatmap_matrix,
  name = "Estimate",
  col = col_fun,
  
  # Row settings - names on right
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "right",  # Changed from "left" to "right"
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
  
  # Column settings
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 0,
  column_names_centered = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10),
  
  # Heatmap appearance
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "gray", lwd = 0.5),
  border = TRUE,
  na_col = "lightgray",
  
  # Clustering
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  
  # Legend settings
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Estimate",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
    at = color_breaks,
    labels = round(color_breaks, 2)
  )
)
draw(ht, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 10), "mm")) # Right padding increased to 10mm

# Save as PNG
png("top_proteins_heatmap2.png", 
    width = 2000,  # Pixel dimensions
    height = 1500, 
    res = 300)     # 300 DPI for high quality
draw(ht, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 10), "mm"))
dev.off()

```



###NOT included##
##Run the model for the archetype ~ clinical variables (important for analysis)
```{r}
# Define clinical and archetype variables
clinical_vars <- colnames(Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS)[2:28]
archetype_vars <- colnames(Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS)[29:31]

results_list <- list()

# Loop through archetypes (outcomes)
for (archetype in archetype_vars) {
  archetype_results <- list()
  
  # Model formula: archetype ~ all clinical variables
  formula_str <- paste0("`", archetype, "` ~ ", paste(sprintf("`%s`", clinical_vars), collapse = " + "))
  
  model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS)
  
  coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
  conf_intervals <- confint.default(model)
  r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
  
  # Extract results for clinical variables only
  for (var in clinical_vars) {
    if (var %in% rownames(coefs)) {
      estimate <- coefs[var, "Estimate"]
      se <- coefs[var, "Std. Error"]
      p_value <- coefs[var, "Pr(>|t|)"]
      ci_lower <- conf_intervals[var, 1]
      ci_upper <- conf_intervals[var, 2]
    } else {
      estimate <- NA
      se <- NA
      p_value <- NA
      ci_lower <- NA
      ci_upper <- NA
    }
    
    archetype_results[[var]] <- data.frame(
      Archetype = archetype,
      Clinical_Variable = var,
      Estimate = estimate,
      Std_Error = se,
      P_value = p_value,
      CI_Lower = ci_lower,
      CI_Upper = ci_upper,
      R2 = r2,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  results_list[[archetype]] <- do.call(rbind, archetype_results)
}

# Combine results
final_results_clinical <- do.call(rbind, results_list)

# Adjust p-values
final_results_clinical$Adjusted_P_value <- p.adjust(final_results_clinical$P_value, method = "fdr")

# Save results
write.csv(final_results_clinical, 
          paste0("Clinical_Archetype_Regression_Results_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Extract significant results
significant_results_clinical <- final_results_clinical[final_results_clinical$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05, ]
significant_results_clinical <- significant_results_clinical[order(significant_results_clinical$Adjusted_P_value), ]

# View top results
head(significant_results_clinical)
```




#Linear regression for dependent variable (proteins ~ clinical varibales )
#The most discriminative omics variables were then investigated for associations with the clinical phenotypes
```{r}
clinical_vars <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS[, 2:28]
proteins_merged <- colnames(Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS)[32:873]
protein_vars <- intersect(top10_proteins$Protein, proteins_merged)
# protein_vars <- proteins_merged

protein_data <- Merged.proteomics.Data.soft.MetS[, protein_vars]
top_protein_clinic <- cbind(clinical_vars, protein_data)
results_list <- list()

for (prot in colnames(protein_data)) {
  for (clinical in colnames(clinical_vars)) {
    formula_str <- paste0("`", prot, "` ~ `", clinical, "`")
    model <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = top_protein_clinic)
    coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients
    conf_intervals <- confint.default(model)
    r2 <- summary(model)$r.squared
    
    # The predictor's coefficient is always the second row
    estimate <- coefs[2, "Estimate"]
    se <- coefs[2, "Std. Error"]
    p_value <- coefs[2, "Pr(>|t|)"]
    ci_lower <- conf_intervals[2, 1]
    ci_upper <- conf_intervals[2, 2]
    
    results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Protein = prot,
      Clinical = clinical,
      Estimate = estimate,
      Std_Error = se,
      P_value = p_value,
      CI_Lower = ci_lower,
      CI_Upper = ci_upper,
      R2 = r2,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

final_results <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
final_results$Adjusted_P_value <- p.adjust(final_results$P_value, method = "fdr")
write.csv(final_results, paste0("protein_clinical_Regression_Results_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
significant_results_protein_clinical <- final_results[final_results$Adjusted_P_value < 0.05, ]
head(significant_results_protein_clinical[order(significant_results_protein_clinical$Adjusted_P_value), ])

```

```{r}
library(VennDiagram)

# Extract proteins for each archetype
list1 <- significant_results$Protein[significant_results$Archetype == "Archetypes 1"]
list2 <- significant_results$Protein[significant_results$Archetype == "Archetypes 2"]
list3 <- significant_results$Protein[significant_results$Archetype == "Archetypes 3"]
list4 <- significant_results$Protein[significant_results$Archetype == "Archetypes 4"]

venn_data <- list(
  "Arch 1" = list1,
  "Arch 2" = list2,
  "Arch 3" = list3,
  "Arch 4" = list4
)

venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
  x = venn_data,
  filename = NULL,
  fill = c("#8dd3c7", "#fb8072", "#fdb462", "#80b1d3"),
  alpha = 0.5,
  cex = 2,#Font size for the numbers
  cat.cex = 2.5,#Font size for category labels
  cat.pos = 0,
  cat.dist = 0.1,
  margin = 0.1,
  main = "Overlap of Archetype-Associated Proteins",

)

grid.draw(venn.plot)

# Save as PNG (not with ggsave)

unique_to_1 <- setdiff(list1, c(list1, list2, list3))
```

```{r}
top10_proteins <- significant_results %>%
  group_by(Archetype) %>%
  arrange(Adjusted_P_value, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  ungroup()
top10_proteins <- top10_proteins %>%
  mutate(
    Protein_Short = case_when(
      str_detect(Protein, "\\|[A-Za-z0-9\\.]+_HUMAN") ~ str_extract(Protein, "(?<=\\|)[A-Za-z0-9\\.]+(?=_HUMAN)"),
      str_detect(Protein, "__[A-Z0-9]+_HUMAN") ~ str_extract(Protein, "(?<=__)[A-Z0-9]+(?=_HUMAN)"),
      TRUE ~ Protein
    )
  )
top10_proteins <- top10_proteins %>%
  group_by(Archetype) %>%
  mutate(Protein_Short_Unique = make.unique(Protein_Short)) %>%
  ungroup()

write.csv(top10_proteins, paste0("top10_proteins_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
heatmap_matrix <- top10_proteins %>%
  dplyr::select(Protein_Short_Unique, Archetype, Estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Archetype, values_from = Estimate) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(heatmap_matrix) <- heatmap_matrix$Protein_Short_Unique
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix %>%
  dplyr::select(-Protein_Short_Unique)
heatmap_matrix <- as.matrix(heatmap_matrix)
mode(heatmap_matrix) <- "numeric"
heatmap_matrix_clust <- heatmap_matrix
heatmap_matrix_clust[is.na(heatmap_matrix_clust)] <- 0

# Remove rows that are all NA in the original matrix, if any
keep_rows <- rowSums(!is.na(heatmap_matrix)) > 0
heatmap_matrix <- heatmap_matrix[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
heatmap_matrix_clust <- heatmap_matrix_clust[keep_rows, , drop = FALSE]
row_order <- hclust(dist(heatmap_matrix_clust))$order
max_abs_value <- max(abs(heatmap_matrix), na.rm = TRUE)
color_breaks <- c(
  -max_abs_value,
  -max_abs_value / 2,
  0,
  max_abs_value / 2,
  max_abs_value
)

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  breaks = color_breaks,
  colors = c("darkblue", "dodgerblue", "#FFFDD0", "salmon", "darkred")
)
ht <- Heatmap(
  heatmap_matrix,
  name = "Estimate",
  col = col_fun,
  show_row_names = TRUE,
  row_names_side = "right",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_rot = 0,
  column_names_centered = TRUE,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "gray", lwd = 0.5),
  border = TRUE,
  na_col = "lightgray",
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  row_order = row_order,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title = "Estimate",
    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
    legend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
    at = color_breaks,
    labels = round(color_breaks, 2)
  )
)

draw(ht, heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 10), "mm"))

# Save as PNG
png("top_proteins_heatmap.png", 
    width = 2000,  # Pixel dimensions
    height = 1500, 
    res = 300)     # 300 DPI for high quality
draw(ht, padding = unit(c(2, 2, 2, 10), "mm"))
dev.off()
```



#Ultimate the for combined plots of heatmap and the bubble plot
```{r}
# --- LIBRARIES ---
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)

# Ensure protein and archetype order are fixed and consistent
protein_levels <- union(
  unique(top10_proteins$Protein_Short),
  unique(significant_results_protein_clinical$Protein_Short_Unique)
)

archetype_levels <- unique(top10_proteins$Archetype)

# --- Tile data for heatmap ---
tile_data <- top10_proteins %>%
  mutate(
    Protein_Short = factor(Protein_Short, levels = rev(protein_levels)),
    Archetype = factor(Archetype, levels = archetype_levels)
  )

# --- Significance stars column ---
get_significance <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("")
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")
  else if (p < 0.01) return("**")
  else if (p < 0.05) return("*")
  else return("")
}

tile_data$stars <- sapply(tile_data$Adjusted_P_value, get_significance)

# --- Make a complete grid for heatmap ---
tile_data_full <- tidyr::complete(
  tile_data,
  Protein_Short = protein_levels,
  Archetype = archetype_levels,
  fill = list(Estimate = NA, stars = "")
)
bubble_data <- significant_results_protein_clinical %>%
  mutate(
    Clinical = recode(
      Clinical,
      "u3talteru" = "Age",
      "u3csex" = "Gender",
      "u3tgewi" = "Weight",
      "u3tgroe" = "Height",
      "u3tbmi" = "BMI",
      "u3tbmiwho" = "WHO_BMI_Category",
      "u3twhrat" = "WHR",
      "u3twhratc" = "WHR_Category",
      "u3tsysmm" = "SBP",
      "u3tdiamm" = "DBP",
      "u3twhoish" = "Hypertension",
      "u3tglukfastn" = "Fasting_glucose",
      "u3tgluk2n" = "Glucose_2h",
      "u3tdm110y15" = "Diabetes_WHO",
      "u3tinsfastn" = "Fasting_serum_insulin",
      "u3tins2n" = "Insulin_2h",
      "u3tmsidfup" = "Metabolic_Syndrome_IDF",
      "u3thoma2_b" = "HOMA_Beta",
      "u3thoma2_s" = "HOMA_Sensitivity",
      "u3thoma2_ir" = "HOMA_IR",
      "u3tquickin" = "Insulin_Sensitivity_Quicki",
      "u3lk_choln" = "Cholesterol",
      "u3lk_hdln" = "HDL",
      "u3lk_ldln" = "LDL",
      "u3lk_trin" = "TG",
      "u3lk_krean" = "Creatinine",
      "u3l_hbavn" = "HbA1c",
      "u3h_crp" = "hsCRP"
    ),
    Protein_Short_Unique = as.character(Protein_Short_Unique),
    Protein_Short = Protein_Short_Unique,
    Protein_Short = factor(Protein_Short, levels = rev(protein_levels)),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(Adjusted_P_value)
  ) %>%
  filter(!Clinical %in% c(
    "Gender",
    "WHO_BMI_Category",
    "WHR_Category",
    "Hypertension",
    "Diabetes_WHO",
    "Metabolic_Syndrome_IDF"
  ))

# --- Full grid for bubble plot ---
phenotype_levels <- unique(bubble_data$Clinical)

bubble_data_full <- tidyr::complete(
  bubble_data,
  Protein_Short = protein_levels,
  Clinical = phenotype_levels
)
col_fun <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue", "dodgerblue", "#FFFDD0", "salmon", "darkred"))
max_abs_value <- max(abs(tile_data$Estimate), na.rm = TRUE)
color_breaks <- seq(-max_abs_value, max_abs_value, length.out = 5)
p_heatmap <- ggplot(tile_data_full, aes(x = Archetype, y = Protein_Short, fill = Estimate)) +
  geom_tile(color = "gray", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = col_fun(100),
    limits = c(-max_abs_value, max_abs_value),
    breaks = color_breaks,
    labels = round(color_breaks, 2),
    name = "Estimate",
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = stars), size = 8, fontface = "bold", na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.8),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

print(p_heatmap)
p_bubble <- ggplot(
  bubble_data_full,
  aes(x = Clinical, y = Protein_Short, size = neg_log10_p, color = Estimate)
) +
  geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "brown",
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Effect Size",
    na.value = "white"
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    name = "-log10(P)",
    range = c(3, 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = "Phenotypes",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

print(p_bubble)
combined <- p_heatmap + p_bubble +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, widths = c(0.32, 0.68))

print(combined)
ggsave(
  "bubble_plot_only_proteins.png",
  p_bubble,
  width = 12,
  height = length(protein_levels) * 0.5 + 2,
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "combined_ggplot_heatmap_bubble_proteins.png",

  width = 20,
  height = length(protein_levels) * 0.5 + 2,

  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "bubble_plot_only_proteins.pdf",

)

  "combined_ggplot_heatmap_bubble_proteins.pdf",

  height = length(protein_levels) * 0.5 + 2,

)
```

```{r}
  if (p < 0.001) return("***")

  if (p < 0.05)  return("*")

}

  )
```
